title: a16z Podcast: VR, AR, and Beyond: The New Medium of Human Experience

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: The building blocks for VR and AR are finally here -- but the content is just beginning.
reader_summary.overview: The building blocks for VR and AR are finally here -- but the content is just beginning. So everything you'll actually experience and consume in these new mediums over the next few years is being built right now. Formats aren't yet defined or locked down, and the field is bubbling up with experiments in forms, formats and genres.

key_points.text: Formats aren't yet defined or locked down, and the field is bubbling up with experiments in forms, formats and genres.
As we begin to have real time rendered characters and AI-driven environments that you can interact with.
Are these mediums inherently social -- or just the opposite?
